subject: The 2AM habit 96% of users share
preview_text: We analyzed 10,000 listeners and found the one thing they all do at 2AM. It changes how you hear everything.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, we looked at 10,000 Loudify users and found something shocking. 96% of you tune the app between 1AM and 3AM. Not at noon. Not during commute. At 2AM.

Turns out, that's when your brain finally stops filtering background noise. The HVAC hum? Gone. The fridge buzz? Silent. You're alone with your headphones, and the volume slider suddenly feels like a wall. That's when you grab Loudify.

We designed AutoEQ to recognize your headphones the moment they connect—no settings, no pairing. But the real trick is the +200% boost. At 2AM, you don't need more volume. You need clean volume. Loudify gives you both, so that podcast or track hits exactly where it should.
Open the app tonight. Tap the Sound DNA tab. See what your 2AM self tuned last week. P.S. The top streak on the leaderboard? Someone with 63 days in a row. You could be next.
